narrative: Thick oak groans, then shatters with a thunderous detonation of timber as armored shoulders strike the barricade. Iron-shod splinters erupt like shrapnel across the cobblestones. The Gauntlets of the Dawn-Titan hum with residual solar heat, searing the splintered grain where massive fists tore the gate apart from its iron hinges. Drilled soldiers tumble backward, scrambling over one another in a panic as dust and pulverized bark choke the damp air. The sergeant, his face pale beneath a battered nasal helm, stumbles to his feet and levels a notched shortsword with a trembling hand. "Hold the breach! By the Iron Gate, don't let the beast through!" he screams, spitting blood and rallying three remaining piked guards who rush forward to form a bristling wall of steel against the settling ruin.

choices.text: Ramslam through the advancing pikemen with absolute brute force
Leap over the collapsing debris to flank the trembling sergeant
Deafen the guards with a terrifying roar channeled through the gauntlets

extractedMemories.summary: Smashed through the military gate's primary timber barricade using the Gauntlets of the Dawn-Titan, scattering the defending garrison.
